route: /style-board/ (the style board: module testimonials:carousel, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: On phones only one quote card shows at a time, but the subgrid that lines up the cards' rules (reference.css:506-508) still sizes every slide to the tallest quote. The shortest sample's card has an empty band of about 80px between its five-line quote and the rule, and the attribution is pushed down with it.
findings.reference: The competitor's quote cards close a fixed space under each quote, followed by the bold name. No card carries an empty band inside it.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css, apply the shared subgrid rows (.track__items grid-template-rows and .track__item / .testimonial grid-row: span 2; grid-template-rows: subgrid) only when every card is in view: add .track[data-fits] to those three selectors, or put them in a min-width media query. A slide shown alone then keeps its own height.

findings.issue: This repeats the earlier finding, which has not been repaired. A hard, dark 1px rule (figcaption border-top) still runs across every quote card between the quote and the attribution, at both widths.
findings.reference: The competitor separates the quote from the bold name with space only, with no rule.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css, set `.block--testimonials .testimonial figcaption { border-top: 0; }` and keep the subgrid row-gap (1rem) as the separation.

findings.issue: The same heading, "What buyers say", renders at two different sizes and apparent weights at both widths: it is smaller and lighter in the longest sample (/resort-wear-manufacturer/) and larger and bold in the shortest (/about-us/). A heading fitted to identical words should come out the same.
findings.reference: The competitor's testimonials heading is one consistent bold H2 wherever the module appears.
findings.fix: In the template's heading fit, check why the h2 on the /resort-wear-manufacturer/ sample gets a smaller fit size or lighter weight (for example, a cap from that page's title or a different heading level or class). Make the same words resolve to the same size and the 700 weight the manifest reports for h2.
